page.content:
Converted Royal Navy corvette of the first global ocean survey.

How HMS Challenger connects

  • Event: Challenger expedition — HMS Challenger was the ship of the 1872–76 expedition.
  • Location: Challenger Deep — Challenger Deep is named for the ship that first sounded the Mariana Trench.

What is HMS Challenger?

HMS Challenger carried naturalists, sounding gear, and dredges on the voyage that found the deep that now bears its name in the Mariana Trench.

Key threads lead to Challenger expedition and Challenger Deep.
